svg.text: Both lists are read from the boards as they stand, not
from when anything moved. The user confirms them
The notes are a running journal started in the morning
and finished in the evening, so the draft is current at
The archive action takes every task in a Done column on
the day's boards and on Chores.
Reset returns the task to the top of its Backlog bucket,
Running the check-out again on the same date updates
that day's log rather than creating a second one.
Chores is out of the account even while it is in play: a
chore being done is not progress on what was committed
to. A date with no focus has an empty account. A date
never checked out stays checkable out.
A draft is not a commit. The notes enter the day's log
The reset touches the day's chosen boards only. Chores
tasks already archived by hand are simply not there to
take. The log stays available as that day's explanation.
What is done and what is still open
